bestBets.overview: No rain according to the BOM. Track should be perfect. Rail in the true. Kick the seven race card (should be at least nine races all things considered) off with an 800m C1 Plate. No's 1,3,5,6,7 all candidates to be up there from the off. SORT CHA MESS fit and well, looks a good chance. The resuming BETTER SWEET creates all the interest. 1st-up from gate one, when last seen fresh won its maiden this track/distance by more than four lengths despite a three wide run from a wide draw. Fitted for this with a win in a two horse trial!  DEEP KHARMA resumes. The mare won its maiden this track and distance at just 2nd start. LADY MILAN hard and fit won her maiden this track and distance last start. She enjoys the claim via Leah Martyn once again. I keep coming back to the 4.

raceTips.comment: LADY MILAN comes of a commanding 4.3 length maiden victory over this track and trip and she will have taken plenty of confidence from it. Her form prior was solid and I think she’ll continue to progress through the grades. BETTER SWEET returns to the races. She was a dominant winner over this short course when resuming last campaign and went on to produce some strong performances against quality opposition. SORT CHA MESS saluted on debut over 800m at Kilcoy back in November and has been placed in all three runs this time in. Ideally suited here at this trip, he’ll be right there at the finish. BOTTLES OF SHELLS comes off a maiden win over 860m at Gatton and she can make her presence felt here.

bestBets.overview: 1100m maiden. Fifteen can run, as predicted once again there is no appetite from the particpants to race in big fields unless the stakes are same. Three on debut, they have all had at least one recent public trial. Four are 1st-up from a spell.  Matthew Dunn was good for three or four, two remain.  Troy Pascoe was good for two, now none. No's 1 & 7 looked to be the pace, race run to suit, the toppy is now out. Initially had four chances in my book, that became two this morning -  CARPET RIDE and the newcomer FRENCH MELODY, alas the former is now also out. The latter draws favourably and trialed close 3rd (to subsequent Grafton & Doomben winner, Zalique) then was close 4th to Why Wait which had already won a race, its only outing to date.

raceTips.comment: CARPET RIDE was lucky not to have fallen when making her debut back in October last year and after a lengthy break, she returned with a solid effort to finish second over 1000m at the Sunshine Coast. Fitter, the slight rise in trip will suit and she’ll be powering home late. FRENCH MELODY makes her debut. She lines up here off two recent Grafton trials and was strong through the line in her latest heat. From the low draw, she looks a top chance. THE GRAND DUTCHY felt the pinch late last start after working hard in the early part to cross. He strips fitter third up and with even luck from a tricky draw, can improve.  SCARLETT BLAZE debuts. She impressed with a recent Beaudesert trial but she too has to overcome a wide draw.

bestBets.overview: 1350m QTIS BM68 (for 3 & 4yo's). Map says 2 & 10 settle ahead, no's 1,6,8 stalking. FIRE BOMBER drops down in class, off back to back Doomben 2nds, both at metro level. Find out today if 1350m is a stretch. CHEVALLUM resumes,  only prior fresh was 2nd over 1200m then came out and shed maiden status over this journey. MISHANI MOET fit and well, if they can run on today this should. HELLO DOLLY DIVA bolted in when resuming, it too will be hoping they can swoop to success.
bestBets.suggestedBet: If they can run on, e/w no's 4 and 7.

raceTips.comment: FIRE BOMBER has been the runner up at his past two and looks well placed to go one better. Beaten only a neck over 1350m at Doomben, he was solid again last time when dropping back to 1200m. He’s unbeaten in two runs here and out to 1350m again looks ideal. CHEVALLUM returns to the races. A progressive gelding, he’s yet to miss the top two in four career starts, he looks ready to go off a recent Doomben trial and is drawn to receive all the favours. HELLO DOLLY DIVA kicked off her campaign with a 4 length romp over 1300m at Toowoomba. She strips fitter and will be strong late. MISHANI MOET comes off a big win over 1200m at the Gold Coast and the rise to 1350m looks ideal.

bestBets.overview: 2150m 0-58. No's 1,4,7, looks to be the remaining pace in a race where only two interest me. OLD FAITHFUL is fit and well, maps a treat, not sure if it matters but note this is the 5yo's  first start around Ipswich having thus far only raced on them wide open spaces at Eagle Farm and Sunshine Coast. PENDING LIST is racing well but from that alley Boris Thornton will earn his keep. I DROVE ALL NIGHT and FLAMING GENESIS round out my numbers purely due to the map.

raceTips.comment: OLD FAITHFUL proved too good over 2200m at the Sunshine Coast two runs back and was just run down late there last time after leading. He drops back slightly in grade and draws to get the right run. PENDING LIST is hard fit and racing well. From the wide gate, he’ll get back and be hitting the line strongly. HE IS THE KISS powered home from the tail to score comfortably over the mile last start at Grafton. He’s untested over this trip but the way he finds the line suggests it may suit. I DROVE ALL NIGHT won well over 1920m at Toowoomba last start. He’s hard fit and the extra journey looks suitable.

bestBets.overview: 1666M 0-62. A no pace race on paper, no's 3 and 7 likely to make the most of that, the 4 may settle closer today. Keep  an ear out for COT announcements. MISHANI WITNESS drops in class, is an unknown quantity beyond 1400m but he won his maiden over that trip. ARTISTIC ENDEAVOUR landed good bets when resuming, been friendless in betting both since. This distance will suit, I dare say there will be a tip about for the 4yo today. More importantly I dare say the horse will be very competitive. TULONG fitter again, maps a treat. LOCH AWE 'never wins' but I wouldn't be at all surprised if it was running on into the finish.

raceTips.comment: ARTISTIC ENDEAVOUR went back to last off a wide gate last time and Doomben and never got into it. Back in grade and out to the mile, he looks ideally placed and gate six can see him settle within striking distance. MISHANI WITNESS will find this much easier than what he’s been contesting and I think  he will relish stepping out to this trip. He’ll get back and be strong late. TULONG strips fitter for the two runs back and looks ready to peak as he steps out the mile. He can make his own luck from the inside draw and he’ll be in it for a long way. LOCH AWE presents and peak fitness and boasts a strong record over this track and trip. He’s drawn beautifully and can certainly figure.

bestBets.overview: 1100m BM68. Fifteen can run but won't, a mere nine have RSVP'd in the affirmative. Pacemakers 5,8,11,21. Tipping in this race is a bit like going out for a meal. "I'll have the steak please", "my apologies we are out of steak", "Oh, then the fish of the day will be fine", "sorry sir, table five just ordered the last piece of fish", "really! well howzabout a Waldorf Salad!", "let me check with chef but I think we maybe out of Waldorf's" -   Dunn was good for two, maybe three, that is now none! #Extraordinary.  Gollan was good for two, still is!  CERTIFIED COPY resumed a winner, 2nd-up holds no fears, draws the best regardless, is now scratched. The freshened INATICK is suitably drawn, is a market watch. MISSILE ONE won well fresh, the map sure had improved, but it too is now staying home. DUKE OF CAMDEN is resuming new blood, gate two at worst, all eyes to the market in these circumstances with this yard. The resuming RUN LUCY RUN maps a lot better now that MORE than half the field has opted out.

raceTips.comment: DUKE OF CAMDEN kicks off for the new yard. He boasts solid NSW provincial form and he does race very well fresh. He found the line well under a hold in a recent Deagon trial and gate two is a big plus.  CERTIFIED COPY kicked off his campaign with a win over 1200m at Rockhampton. Fitter for that outing, he looks a strong chance here from the inside draw. MISSILE ONE proved too good when resuming over 1000m at the Sunshine Cost. She strips fitter and the extra 100m will suit. MISHANI EXTREME is racing well and will appreciate the drop back in grade. He’s unbeaten in two starts at this course but will need luck from the wide gate.

bestBets.overview: 1350m 0-58. 'Only' sixteen can run but won't. No's 1,3,19. looks to be where the pace resides. The outside alley looks to have scared off HOMERIC, gate 13 to be precise. THE TORQUE FACTOR did nicely when 2nd home 1st-up at Grafton, map has improved. CLUBHOUSE draws the best, is invariably thereabouts. Saddlecloth 23 gets a run via MISHANI UNDERCOVER now that it's gained start, looks as good a chance as any. Nice price too.

raceTips.comment: HIDDEN FUTURE comes off a solid effort to finish second last start over 1200m here. The rise to 1350m looks ideal and she’ll be strong late. HOMERIC was the runner up last start over this track and trip. This looks slightly easier but he does have the wide draw to contend with. MISHANI UNDERCOVER was terribly unlucky here two runs back and just held her ground last time when stepping out to the mile at Eagle Farm. Back in grade and back to 1350m, she can improve. BERTUS drops back in grade and draws to get the right run.
